rows: This view is a guess that hasn’t yet been checked against research. A rabbit probably sees almost all the way around itself, most sharply along the horizon, in little detail, with two kinds of colour-sensing cells.
On this trial the colours come from the measured receptor peaks (425, 523 nm). The camera's colours and the display are the app's.

As the light falls, the colours drift toward what the rods take in, which peak near 498 nm. The peak is measured; where the change happens is the app's guess.
